title: SCoFT: Self-Contrastive Fine-Tuning for Equitable Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: User surveys with culturally experienced participants from 5 different countries ranking generated images on description alignment, cultural representation, stereotypes, and offensiveness, supported by automatic image quality and diversity metrics like KID, DIV, and CLIP Score.

Qualitative evaluation and visual comparison of generated images representing people using prosthetics to assess accurate, non-stereotypical, and unbiased representation versus baseline text-to-image models.
